name: Delta-Pi formula
observations: Delta-Pi = [Q(1-lambda_rot)E[P_future] - Q(C_storage + C_handling) - C_transport_storage] - [Q P_spot - C_transport_market]
Block spot sale iff P_spot < floor and open quota >= Q and Delta-Pi > 0

name: Aratdar take formula
observations: M = wholesale - grower; C_bepari = 0.8 x M x 0.70; aratdar_take = 0.6235 x C_bepari

name: Haor breach formula
observations: w = 1/(1+e^((dB+16.5)/1.6)), r = R72/trigger, z = -5 + 3.2r + 2.6w + 2.0 vulnerability + 1.2 seasonal_exposure, p = 1/(1+e^-z)
